gloss_en: I have an important email from work
notes: [tech] email→imeːl (/eː/ mid-long loan vowel, in the gilit inventory; blanc1964). ʕindi 'I have', iš-šuɣul 'work' (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: اِشْتَرَيت laptop جِدِيد بَسّ wifi ضَعِيف
raw: اشتريت laptop جديد بس wifi ضعيف
ipa: iʃtaˈreːt labtub dʒiˈdiːd ˈbass wifi dˤɑˈʕiːf
gloss_en: I bought a new laptop but the wifi is weak
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]; Watson 2002); wifi→wifi. bass 'but', ǧīm [dʒ] in jidīd (blanc1964). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: there is a broken printer we must fix
notes: [tech] printer→brintar (initial /p/→[b]; Watson 2002). aku 'there is' existential, xarbān 'broken' (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I saw a very nice video
notes: [tech] video→fidiu (/v/→[f]; gilit has no /v/; blanc1964). hwāya 'very' (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] password→baswuːrd (/p/→[b], medial embed; Watson 2002). māl 'of' Iraqi genitive exponent (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I have an important meeting in the morning
notes: [work] meeting→miːtinɡ (needs final /ɡ/, which the gilit inventory declares; blanc1964). iṣ-ṣubuḥ 'the morning' (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I spoke with the company manager yesterday
notes: [work] manager→manadʒar (ǧīm [dʒ] vs Cairene [manaɡar]; Watson 2002). ḥačēt 'I spoke' (kaf-affricate چ, erwin1963), wiyya 'with', il-bārḥa 'yesterday' (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I paid the bill in cash, not by card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ (final embed). mu (مو) predicate negation (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I left the car at the garage
notes: [automotive] garage→ɡaːradʒ (/ɡ/ + ǧīm [dʒ], both in the gilit inventory). xallēt 'I left', ʕand 'at' (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I think this is very expensive
notes: [opinion] think→θink (interdental /θ/ RETAINED — gilit keeps the interdentals; blanc1964). āni 'I', hāða retained /ð/, hwāya 'very' (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: the charger of the mobile is broken
notes: [automotive] charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/tʃ/→[ʃ] in the loan; Watson 2002; ǧīm [dʒ]). māl 'of', xarbān 'broken' (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

sentence: delivery يُوصَل الصُّبُح إِن شَاء الله
raw: delivery يوصل الصبح إن شاء الله
ipa: dilifari ˈjuːsˤɑl ˈɑsˤsˤubuħ ˈʔin ˈʃaːʔ ˈallah
gloss_en: the delivery arrives in the morning, God willing
notes: [commerce] delivery→dilifari (/v/→[f]; initial embed). yūṣal 'arrives' (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: he called me on the phone yesterday
notes: [tech] Arabic-script loan tilifūn 'telephone' (via Ott. Turkish), attested Iraqi [tilifuːn]; xābar 'to phone' (erwin1963); pipeline reads the native graphemes → matches attested (cf. gold ar-IQ-018). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: bring a glass of water from the kitchen
notes: [daily] Arabic-script loan glāṣ 'glass/tumbler' (<Eng. glass, Turkish-mediated), attested Iraqi [ɡlɑːsˤ] with the dialectal گ; pipeline reads گ as /ɡ/ → matches attested. jīb imperative (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: turn on the fan, the weather is hot
notes: [daily] Arabic-script loan pānka 'ceiling fan' (Anglo-Indian punkah, Persian/Gulf-mediated), attested Iraqi [ˈpaːnka] with پ=/p/; pipeline reads پ as /p/ → matches attested (erwin1963 s.v. panka). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I lost my mobile from my pocket
notes: [tech] loan mōbāyil; attested [moˈbaːjil] with /oː/ for و; pipeline reads و as /uː/ → 'ˈdˤɑːʕ ˈminniː lmuˈːbaːjil ˈmin ˈdʒeːbiː' (WRONG). jēb 'pocket' with ǧīm [dʒ] (erwin1963). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: the car is automatic, not manual
notes: [automotive] loan ōtōmātīk; attested [ʔoːtomaːˈtiːk] with /oː/ for و and plain final /k/; pipeline BOTH reads و as /uː/ AND over-applies gilit kaf-affrication to the final ك → 'assaˈjjaːra ʔuːtuːmaˈːtiːtʃ ˈmuː ˈʕaːdiː' (WRONG on two counts; the affrication is lexical, not automatic — cf. blanc1964 §3.25, 'kilo' does not affricate). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: how are you? what's new now?
notes: [arabizi] 3arabi spelling of شْلَونَك؟ شَكُو مَاكُو الْحِين (7=/ħ/); šlōnak + šaku māku idiom (erwin1963; blanc1964); pipeline has no Arabizi path → hand-derived from the Baghdadi reading. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: I'll go to the market tomorrow
notes: [arabizi] spelling of آنِي رَح أَرُوح لِلسُّوگ بَاچِر (7=/ħ/, soug=سوگ گ=/ɡ/, ch=چ=/tʃ/); āni 'I', raḥ future, baačir 'tomorrow' (erwin1963). Pipeline drops the چ of باچِر and has no Arabizi path → hand-derived (baːtʃir restored). table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)

gloss_en: do you have tea? put some cardamom in it
notes: [arabizi] spelling of عِنْدَك چَاي؟ حُطّ بِيه هيل (3=/ʕ/, ch=چ=/tʃ/, 7=/ħ/); čāy 'tea', ḥuṭṭ bī 'put in it', hēl 'cardamom' (erwin1963). Pipeline has no Arabizi path → hand-derived from the Baghdadi reading. table: default pan-Arabic (Watson 2002; Holes 2004)
